title: Intrinsic characterization of polymatroid combinatorial-flat lattices
author: Crowley, Colin; Simpson, Connor; Wang, Botong
work: Combinatorial flats and Schubert varieties of subspace arrangements

primary_locator.required_new_core: nullity/geometric-part characterization, unique simple-lattice rank construction, maximal join-irreducible chains and mutually inverse multiset/lattice maps with rank-decreasing arguments

difficulty_reason: The converse constructs a polymatroid from maximal join-irreducibles and proves two mutually inverse rank-decreasing maps using the nullity/geometric-part condition. This reconstruction in Theorem 3.20 is distinct from proving structural properties of a previously given polymatroid lattice and is a substantive nonroutine lattice classification.
